remarks: Well-Positioned Beverage Retail Business with Growth Potential in Norwalk that  is a modern, neighborhood-focused wine and liquor store offering a thoughtfully curated selection of premium whiskey, wine, craft beer, and spirits. This is not your typical liquor store-It has has built a loyal customer base by combining quality products with exceptional service in a prime, walkable Norwalk location.  Customers consistently praise the store for its friendly, knowledgeable staff, strong craft beer program, and excellent spirits selection. As one reviewer put it: "Nothing 'old' about this spirits store-it's breaking new ground in treating customers right."  Located within walking distance of numerous apartment buildings off West Avenue, Old Post Spirits benefits from steady local foot traffic and repeat clientele. The business is well positioned for an owner-operator or investor looking to step into an established operation with room to grow through expanded product lines, tastings, and marketing.
